description: Retrieve DeerDawn memory through one tool. Action portfolio reads across every project at once, for what recurs in more than one. Some retrieval actions update selection counters, and every invocation records usage telemetry.

action.description: The kind of memory to retrieve. Use portfolio for what is shared across projects.

project_id.description: Project id (project_1a2b3c4d-...) or the project's exact name. Omit to use the active project.

query.description: Topic or path query for search, paths, entities, or portfolio.

scope.description: Entity scope for action=entities. workspace looks across ALL of this account's projects, which is how you find a service, person, or decision appearing in more than one; project stays inside a single project.

name: recall
